blocks.text: North Korea on Tuesday warned of an “immediate and powerful counteraction” if South Korea intrudes even “a millimeter” into its territory, after Seoul signaled corresponding measures over a recent land mine blast at the inter-Korean border that it has blamed on Pyongyang. The North’s foreign ministry issued the statement a day after the South’s military concluded the mines planted by North Korea caused the Sept. 21 blast on the southern side of the Demilitarized Zone that left two South Korean soldiers critically injured.
